newsitem.title: PANAMA: Panama moves drug lord to maximum security cell.
newsitem.headline: Panama moves drug lord to maximum security cell.

text.p: Panamanian authorities have moved an accused Colombian drug lord from a violent prison to a maximum security cell at police headquarters, a National Police spokesman said on Thursday.
Jose Castrillon Henao was moved late on Wednesday from Modelo Prison, which is to be destroyed after police guards there were filmed beating naked prisoners.

The spokesman said Castrillon, who was allegedly in charge of the Cali cartel's seagoing operations and has an estimated worth of $50 million, was taken to a maximum security cell recently built for him at police headquarters in Panama City.
The spokesman said police had to carry Castrillon because he had trouble walking because of lower back problems.

Castrillon was at the centre of a Panamanian political scandal earlier this year when it was discovered he apparently gave two checks for $51,000 to President Ernesto Perez Balladares' 1994 presidential campaign.
